title: Manipur Police SI Dr Asem Satyapati Devi Receives Kendriya Grihmantri Dakshata Padak for Investigation
summary: Manipur Police Sub-Inspector Dr. Asem Satyapati Devi, posted at Lilong Police Station, Thoubal, receives the Kendriya Grihmantri Dakshata Padak for excellence in investigation.
body:
THOUBAL: Dr. Asem Satyapati Devi, a Woman Sub-Inspector of Manipur Police currently posted at Lilong Police Station in Thoubal district, has been awarded the Kendriya Grihmantri Dakshata Padak in the field of Investigation.

The award recognises her professional competence and contribution to criminal investigation.

The Director General of Police, Manipur, along with all ranks of the state police, congratulated Dr. Satyapati Devi on receiving the prestigious recognition.

Her achievement highlights the dedication and professionalism of Manipur Police personnel in carrying out their responsibilities.
